struct Part
  PartKind kind
  std::string text
  std::string digest
  std::string media_type
  std::string call_id
  std::string name
  std::string arguments
struct Message
  Role role
  std::vector<Part> parts
struct Tool
  std::string name
  std::string description
  std::string parameters
struct Temperature
  std::int64_t milli
struct Options
  std::int64_t max_output
  std::optional<Temperature> temperature
  std::vector<std::string> stop
  std::string json_schema
struct Request
  std::string model
  std::vector<Message> messages
  std::vector<Tool> tools
  std::optional<Options> options
  std::map<std::string, std::string> extensions
  std::vector<std::string> required_extensions
  std::vector<std::string> guarantees
  std::string credential
struct Target
  std::string model
  std::string selection_policy
struct RequestContent
  std::vector<Message> messages
  std::vector<Tool> tools
  std::optional<Options> options
  std::map<std::string, std::string> extensions
  std::vector<std::string> required_extensions
  std::vector<std::string> guarantees
  std::string credential
struct RequestV2
  Target target
  RequestContent content
struct Usage
  std::int64_t input
  std::int64_t output
  std::int64_t cached
struct Cost
  std::int64_t micros
  std::string currency
struct Reply
  ReplyOutcome outcome
  std::string reason
  Message message
  StopReason stop_reason
  Usage usage
  std::string host
  std::string model
